name: A long grind keeps Boop animated, and its mood drifts
judge: Twenty minutes of plain work, then a good finish. Boop should stay alive through the grind and the finish should feel big.
reasonable: A face every several minutes, mood drifting toward engaged or determined, or easing and returning. At the end, a success with excited, proud or happy feeling and real size.
unreasonable: Sitting blank for most of the grind, moods flipping back and forth within a minute, going sad or grumpy, or a flat finish after twenty minutes.
